briefdescription.para: List of known vector-functions libraries.

detaileddescription.para: The vector-functions library defines, which functions are vectorizable and with which factor. The library can be specified by either frontend, or a commandline option, and then used by addVectorizableFunctionsFromVecLib for filling up the tables of vectorizable functions.
